en.html:
Strength seemed to be leaking through every pore. A weakness as though someone were wringing my heart.

...Bad. Let this feeling fill me, and it would surely be the end.

I would sink without limit, never to return.


...Not yet.


Not yet... that was not permitted!

I had neither fulfilled my duty nor received my punishment!

皮膚の毛穴から活力が抜け出てゆくような感覚。
　心臓を絞られているようでもある脱力感。

　……まずい。
　この感覚に満たされてしまえば、きっと終わりだ。

　何処までも沈んでゆき、二度と戻らぬに違いない。
　

　……まだだ。


　まだ……<ruby>それ<rt>・・</rt></ruby>は許されない！
　俺は役目を果たし終えず、罰せられてもいないのだ！

I grafted my faltering consciousness together and kept it in the real world. That alone consumed most of my remaining vitality. Even so, it was too early to list my complaints.

The enemy would attack at once! A counterattack might be out of the question, but I must at least prepare to defend...

en.html:
Only the Metal Echo still reaching me continued to sing of its desire to fight. Even stripped of language, that concentrated whirl of murderous intent left no room for misunderstanding.

But the machine was descending. It glared at me, stretched out its hand, even seemed to struggle—all in vain. Gravity drew it down.

There was no conspicuous damage to the demon-shaped dragoon. Its wings and cylinders were intact.

Then... why?

ja.html:
届く<ruby>装甲通信<rt>メタルエコー</rt></ruby>だけは、なお俺への闘志を唄っていた。
　凝縮された殺戮欲の渦は、言語の形を喪失していて
さえ誤解の余地がない。

　しかし、その騎体は落ちてゆく。
　俺を睨み、手を伸ばし、足掻くような仕草すら見せ
ながら――全ては虚しく。重力に引き下ろされてゆく。

　悪魔の姿の竜騎兵に、目立った損傷はない。
　<ruby>翼甲<rt>ウイング</rt></ruby>も<ruby>気筒<rt>バレル</rt></ruby>も無事だ。

　なのに……何故？

I watched the enemy dwindle into the distance. Not falling—barely gliding, but at considerable speed. Land like that, and it would suffer substantial damage.

Even if the thick armor prevented death... serious injury would be unavoidable.

............The conclusion of self-destruction.

en.html:
Leaving that undigested feeling in my heart, I turned away. Whatever else, the obstacle was gone.

I must hurry to Kenchoji. This unforeseen development had swallowed my time. How long had it been since Miss Kanae's call?

Whatever was happening, I hoped I was not too late.

If only the Prince and the Chief... were safe...

心中に消化不良を残しつつ、俺は身を翻した。
　とにかく――障害は除かれたのだ。

　建朝寺へ急ごう。
　思わぬ異変に時間を蕩尽してしまった。香奈枝嬢の
電話から、既にどれだけ経ったか。

　何事が起きているにせよ、手遅れでなければ良いの
だが……。
　親王と署長が……無事であれば……。
